testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.data.datasource.postgres.PostgresConnectorIntegrationTests

testcase.name: discovery lists the configured schemas only and carries no secrets()
statements that write never reach the server through the executor either()
a wrong password is a typed failure and appears nowhere()
a hostile parameter value is data, never SQL()
row limits, paging and the byte cap bound the result()
even a role with write privileges cannot write through a connector session, however the statement arrives()
without the explicit allow-list a local or private database is refused()
parameters are bound, columns are typed, and rows come back as JSON()
a runaway query is stopped by the statement timeout()
connections are closed after every call()
a SELECT-only role passes the connection test, a writer passes with a warning, a superuser is refused()
discovery reports primary keys and foreign keys and masks samples before they leave the connector()
